meeting_point: outside Park Street MBTA Station on Boston Common at corner of Tremont Street and Park Street.
accessibility: potential uneven surfaces and moderate inclines
description:
Explore 12,000 years of human activity on Shawmut Peninsula, the lands we now call Boston. Follow in the footsteps of the Native people who first walked here. Learn how they hunted and fished, and worked with clay and textiles.

Uncover geological features and archaeological sites on this guided walk on and around Boston Common.

Hear the stories of how the Massachusett first encountered strange people from afar, European explorers and settlers, who would then claim this land for their own.
what_is_included:
- Guided 90 minute outdoor tour exploring Boston's historic past
- 1 mile tour at a moderate pace, stopping at various sites along the tour

check_in_details:
- Please arrive 10 minutes before the tour start time to find your guide. Tours are held rain or shine.
- Finding Your Guide: All guides carry an 8×11 sign that says “Boston By Foot Walking Tours.”
- Nearest MBTA Station: Park Street (Red & Green Lines)
what_to_bring:
- Comfortable shoes
- Dress for the weather (tours are held rain or shine)
- Water bottle
